title: Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.18566v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets.   We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security agains

translated_title: 重新思考大语言模型路由中的质量：安全条件下的模型与预算选择
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）路由器通过为每个查询选择调用哪个模型以及授予该模型多少输出token，来降低服务成本。现有路由器使用单一质量指标对“模型-预算”动作进行排序，这不适用于混合工作负载：对于普通查询，好的回答应当正确且有用（效用）；而对于安全敏感的查询，好的回答应当拒绝有害请求或抵抗恶意指令（安全）。这两个目标偏好不同的模型和预算。我们提出了SCRouter，一个能够学习何时优先考虑安全以及如何分配token预算的路由器。对于每个“模型-预算”组合，它估计回答在预算内完成的概率，并利用该概率分别预测效用与安全性。一个小型探针（probe）为每个查询确定这两个预测的加权方式。随后，SCRouter通过权衡加权后的效用与安全性来选择模型和预算。
tldr: 该论文提出SCRouter路由器，针对混合工作负载分别预测效用与安全性并按查询动态加权平衡，实现安全条件下的模型与token预算联合选择。
en_tdlr: SCRouter is a router that separately predicts utility and security for each model-budget pair and dynamically balances them per query, enabling security-conditioned model and token-budget selection for mixed workloads.
